<!-- Generated by `ovid2 manual gen-reference`. Do not edit by hand. -->

A pipeline config's *kind* decides which executor command runs, whether a pipeline package and a CDM are required, and which form fields the Submit page shows. Narrative guide: [Running jobs](../04-running-jobs/index.md).

| Kind | Label | Description | Executor | Package | CDM | Created as |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `etl` | ETL | Full format → dedup → map → fix → upload pipeline gated by a CDM. Scaffolds a pipeline package from a template. | `ovid2 etl` | yes | yes | pipeline |
| `analysis` | Analysis | Read-only analysis over an existing installed pipeline package (runs the format stage / per-table formatters). | `ovid2 analysis` | yes | no | pipeline |
| `dq_checks` | DQ checks | EDC report-cycle data-quality checks. No formatter chain; select one or more report cycles. | `ovid2 dq_checks` | no | yes | pipeline |
| `health` | Health | Data-health checks against a CDM. No formatter chain; may refresh /data, so the input tree is mounted read-write. | `ovid2 health` | no | yes | pipeline |
| `copy` | Copy | One-shot address-to-address copy that bypasses the formatter / mapper / fixer stages. | `ovid2 tools copy` | no | no | pipeline |
| `move` | Move | Driver-native successor to copy — same shape, routes I/O through native drivers and supports strict CDM type checks. | `ovid2 tools move` | no | no | pipeline |
| `export` | Export | Full-table export of one Data Space table to csv / xlsx, run in the background. Created from the Data Space table page only. | `ovid2 tools export-table` | no | no | job only |

Deprecated aliases accepted on input: `cdm` → `etl`.
